ei.title: 8번: A Caterpillar That Mimics a Snake
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: With predators hiding around every corner, it's not easy for many animals to survive in the wild. That's why some have developed camouflage to trick their predators. The caterpillar of a moth called Hemeroplanes triptolemus, found in many areas of Africa and South America, is one example. It mimics a snake to scare away birds, which like to eat the caterpillars but are preyed upon by snakes. The snake caterpillar does this by inflating its front part to form a diamond-shaped head. When it does this, eye-shaped markings on its head get bigger, making the caterpillar look like a snake with large eyes. With the caterpillar's camouflage giving it a frightening appearance like that of a predator, the birds stay away. It can also move its body like a striking snake, even though it can't bite and isn't poisonous.

questions.passage: With predators hiding around every corner, it's not easy for many animals to (A)[perish / survive] in the wild. That's why some have developed camouflage to (B)[help / trick] their predators. The caterpillar of a moth called Hemeroplanes triptolemus, found in many areas of Africa and South America, is one example. It (C)[mimics / avoids] a snake to scare away birds, which like to eat the caterpillars but are preyed upon by snakes. The snake caterpillar does this by inflating its front part to form a diamond-shaped head. When it does this, eye-shaped markings on its head get bigger, making the caterpillar look like a snake with large eyes. With the caterpillar's camouflage giving it a frightening appearance like that of a predator, the birds stay away. It can also move its body like a striking snake, even though it can't bite and isn't poisonous.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) survive=생존하다 / perish=죽다 (B) trick=속이다 / help=돕다 (C) mimics=흉내 내다 / avoids=피하다
det.analysis:
① survive—trick—mimics: 포식자 사이에서 생존(survive)하려 위장으로 포식자를 속이고(trick) 뱀을 흉내(mimics) ←정답
② perish—trick—avoids: (A) 포식자 때문에 '죽는' 게 아니라 '생존'이 어렵다 (C) 뱀을 흉내 냄
③ survive—help—mimics: (B) 위장은 포식자를 '돕는' 게 아니라 '속이는' 것
④ perish—help—avoids: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 야생 생존(survive) → 위장으로 포식자를 속임(trick) → 뱀을 흉내(mimics)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) developed=발달시켰다 / abandoned=버렸다 (B) scare=겁줘 쫓다 / attract=끌어들이다 (C) preyed=잡아먹히는 / protected=보호받는
det.analysis:
① abandoned—scare—preyed: (A) 위장을 '버린' 게 아니라 '발달'시킴
② developed—scare—preyed: 위장을 발달(developed)시켜 새를 겁줘 쫓고(scare), 새는 뱀에게 잡아먹힘(preyed) ←정답
③ developed—attract—protected: (B) 새를 '끌어들이는' 게 아니라 '쫓음' (C) 새는 뱀에게 '보호받는' 게 아니라 '잡아먹힘'
④ abandoned—attract—protected: (A)(B)(C) 모두 반대
det.tip: 위장을 발달(developed) → 새를 겁줘 쫓음(scare) → 새는 뱀에게 잡아먹힘(preyed upon)

questions.passage: With predators hiding around every corner, it's not easy for many animals to survive in the wild. That's why some have developed camouflage to trick their predators. The caterpillar of a moth called Hemeroplanes triptolemus, found in many areas of Africa and South America, is one example. It mimics a snake to scare away birds, which like to eat the caterpillars but are preyed upon by snakes. The snake caterpillar does this by (A)[deflating / inflating] its front part to form a diamond-shaped head. When it does this, eye-shaped markings on its head get (B)[smaller / bigger], making the caterpillar look like a snake with large eyes. With the caterpillar's camouflage giving it a (C)[frightening / soothing] appearance like that of a predator, the birds stay away. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) inflating=부풀리기 / deflating=수축시키기 (B) bigger=더 커진 / smaller=더 작아진 (C) frightening=무서운 / soothing=진정시키는
det.analysis:
① deflating—bigger—soothing: (A) 머리를 만들려면 앞부분을 '부풀림'
② inflating—smaller—soothing: (B) 눈 무늬가 '더 커짐' (C) 포식자 같은 '무서운' 겉모습
③ inflating—bigger—frightening: 앞부분을 부풀려(inflating) 눈 무늬가 더 커지고(bigger) 무서운(frightening) 겉모습이 됨 ←정답
④ deflating—smaller—frightening: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 앞부분 부풀림(inflating) → 눈 무늬 더 커짐(bigger) → 무서운(frightening) 겉모습

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① predators=포식자 ② mimics→avoids (부적절) ③ markings=무늬 ④ poisonous=독이 있는
det.analysis:
① predators: 곳곳에 숨은 포식자 — 적절
② avoids: 애벌레가 뱀을 '피한다(avoids)'? 새를 겁주려면 뱀을 '흉내(mimics)' 내야 함 ←정답
③ markings: 눈 모양 무늬 — 적절
④ poisonous: 물지도 못하고 독도 없다 — 적절
det.tip: 새를 쫓으려면 뱀을 mimics(흉내). avoids(피하다)는 정반대

det.korean: ① survive=생존하다 ② diamond-shaped=다이아몬드 모양의 ③ bigger→smaller (부적절) ④ striking=덤벼드는
det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 head의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: head: (A) 머리(신체 부위, 명사) (B) ~로 가다/향하다(동사)
det.analysis:
① (A) 머리 (B) ~로 가다: 다이아몬드 모양 head=머리, head home=집으로 가다 ←정답
② (A) 우두머리 (B) 머리: (A) 부풀려 만든 신체 부위라 '우두머리'는 부적절
③ (A) 머리 (B) 이끌다: (B) head home은 '집을 이끌다'가 아니라 '집으로 가다'
④ (A) ~로 가다 (B) 머리: (A)(B) 모두 뒤바뀜
det.tip: head의 다의어: 머리(명사) vs ~로 가다(동사, head home)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "an animal that lives by hunting and eating other animals"

det.korean: prey=먹잇감 / insect=곤충 / caterpillar=애벌레 / predator=포식자
det.analysis:
① prey: 먹잇감 — 사냥하는 쪽이 아니라 잡아먹히는 대상
② insect: 곤충 — 사냥 여부와 무관
③ caterpillar: 애벌레 — 사냥하는 동물이 아님
④ predator: 다른 동물을 사냥해 잡아먹고 사는 동물 ←정답
det.tip: hunting + eating other animals = 포식자(predator)

questions.passage: With predators __________ (hide) around every corner, it's not easy for many animals to survive in the wild. That's why some have developed camouflage to trick their predators.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: hide(숨다) → hiding. 'With + 명사 + -ing'(~가 …한 채로) 분사구문
det.analysis: hide를 현재분사 hiding으로 바꿔요. 'With predators hiding around every corner'는 'With + 명사(predators) + 현재분사(hiding)' 형태로 '포식자가 곳곳에 숨어 있는 채로'라는 뜻이에요. 포식자가 '숨는' 능동의 동작이라 -ing형(hiding)이 맞아요.
det.tip: With + 명사 + -ing = ~가 …한 채로. hide → hiding

questions.passage: When it does this, eye-shaped markings on its head get bigger, making the caterpillar look like a snake with large eyes. With the caterpillar's camouflage giving it a __________ (frighten) appearance like that of a predator, the birds stay away.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: frighten(겁주다) → frightening(무서운). 명사 appearance를 꾸미는 분사형 형용사
det.analysis: frighten을 현재분사형 형용사 frightening으로 바꿔요. 뒤의 명사 appearance(겉모습)를 꾸며 '무서운 겉모습'이 돼요. 겉모습이 남을 '겁주는(능동)' 것이라 -ing형(frightening)을 써요. frightened(겁먹은)는 사람이 느끼는 감정이라 여기엔 안 맞아요.
det.tip: 남을 겁주는(능동) → frightening. 겁먹은(감정) → frightened

questions.passage: With predators hiding around every corner, it's not easy for many animals to survive in the wild. That's why some have developed camouflage to trick their predators. The caterpillar of a moth called Hemeroplanes triptolemus, found in many areas of Africa and South America, is one example. It mimics a snake to scare away birds, which like to eat the caterpillars but are preyed upon by snakes. The snake caterpillar does this by inflating its front part to form a diamond-shaped head. When it does this, eye-shaped markings on its head get bigger, making the caterpillar look like a snake with large eyes. With the caterpillar's camouflage giving it a frightening appearance like that of a predator, the birds __________. It can also move its body like a striking snake, even though it can't bite and isn't poisonous.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: come closer=더 다가오다 / stay away=멀리 떨어져 있다 / fall asleep=잠들다 / fight back=반격하다
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 '포식자 같은 무서운 겉모습(frightening appearance)'이 단서예요.
① come closer: 더 다가오다? 무서운 모습과 반대
② stay away: 무서운 겉모습 때문에 새가 '멀리 떨어짐' ←정답
③ fall asleep: 잠들다? 문맥 무관
④ fight back: 반격하다? 겁먹고 물러나는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: 포식자 같은 무서운 겉모습 → 새가 멀리 떨어짐(stay away)

questions.passage: With predators hiding around every corner, it's not easy for many animals to survive in the wild. That's why some have developed camouflage to trick their predators. The caterpillar of a moth called Hemeroplanes triptolemus, found in many areas of Africa and South America, is one example. It mimics a snake to scare away birds, which like to eat the caterpillars but are preyed upon by snakes. The snake caterpillar does this by inflating its front part to form a diamond-shaped head. When it does this, eye-shaped markings on its head get bigger, making the caterpillar __________ a snake with large eyes. With the caterpillar's camouflage giving it a frightening appearance like that of a predator, the birds stay away. It can also move its body like a striking snake, even though it can't bite and isn't poisonous.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: run from=~에서 도망치다 / laugh at=~을 비웃다 / look like=~처럼 보이다 / give up=포기하다
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞뒤 '눈 무늬가 커져 큰 눈의 뱀'이 단서예요.
① run from: 애벌레가 뱀에게서 도망? 문맥과 안 맞음
② laugh at: 뱀을 비웃다? 문맥 무관
③ look like: 눈 무늬가 커져 애벌레가 큰 눈의 뱀'처럼 보임' ←정답
④ give up: 포기하다? 문맥 무관
det.tip: 눈 무늬가 커짐 → 애벌레가 뱀처럼 보임(look like a snake)
